paragraphs.source_en: He also felt that *everyone* had a distinct mission or unique contribution to make. And he was always communicating this to people. I would often overhear him saying things like, “I think you would make an extraordinary business leader.” Or “What a difference you are making as the peacemaker in your family.” Or “You’ll make a great parent someday.” I once randomly asked my father how he defined leadership. He thought for a second and said, “Leadership is communicating to another their worth and potential so clearly they are inspired to see it in themselves.” As he said this, I teared up because it was so genuine. He had always communicated to me my worth and potential, even when I didn’t see it myself.

paragraphs.source_en: The best way to Begin With the End in Mind is to write a personal mission statement, philosophy, or creed. After reading this chapter, many people get excited about writing a mission statement, but then they get busy, one thing leads to another, and the excitement wears off. The fact is you can’t afford *not* to do it. Too much is at stake. There is something incredibly powerful about having a written mission statement—a personal constitution, so to speak—that will guide your life and direct your daily decisions. The key to getting it done is to not overthink it. Remember, it doesn’t have to be perfect; just get started and refine it over time. paragraphs.source_en: - **Free-write.** Sit down, and for fifteen minutes, keep your pen moving. Write down everything that comes to mind about what you’re best at (self-awareness), what you feel you need to do (conscience), and what you would do if you had no limits (imagination). The key is to continue writing until the time is up. When you’re done, do a little editing to form a rough draft of your mission statement. - **Plan a retreat.** Schedule a day when you can get away to some location that inspires you, whether it be the beach, the mountains, or a park. Think through what matters most to you. To spur some ideas, ask yourself questions like the ones below and write down your answers.
